title: [CQ-I03] JetBrains managed VM interface
description:
Objective: Show provisioning/readiness/recovery, actual capabilities and actionable refusal reasons.

Deliverable: JetBrains managed VM interface. This is task I03 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): I02, R06, R10.
definitionOfDone: Provider-ready is not execution-ready or verified.
VM lifecycle controls operate only owned instances.
Fresh verification `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
reopenReason: Unblocked on the human's explicit, repeated instruction ("unblock tasks", then "unblock", 2026-10-27). Plan now instead of parking. Use prerequisites' landed code or approved plans where they exist. Otherwise use their task description, DoD and docs/plans/2026-10-24-ai-code-quality-and-context.md. Name every assumed interface in planningNotes. Keep dependsOn, so WORKING waits until the prerequisites are DONE. If a prerequisite's contract must be designed first, split it out (SPIDR, as with R10a) instead of report_blocked. Re-block only if any possible plan would breach a rail.
priorBlockedReason: Cannot produce an executable consumer-only plan for DoD2 without a producer contract. Source exploration: scripts/local-runner/cli.mjs accepts only doctor, prerequisites, native-smoke; it has no list/provision/reconcile/cancel/cleanup API. R06 lifecycle.mjs provides internal ledger/owner/attempt/lease helpers, not an IDE-callable authority; neither daemon WebSocketServer nor wrappers expose these operations. clientCapabilities.ts intentionally advertises runnerStatus:false and verifiedLocal:false. Declared prerequisite CQ-R10 task-e6411b76f42a43c5b679c725947336af is BACKLOG with no plan/transport contract, and waits on unfinished R09. Need authoritative projected status + ownership-validated control requests/responses, refusal codes, attempt/generation/lease checks and host routing before planning Swing controls. Do not replace this with disabled-only controls, direct unverified Multipass actions, caller-supplied ownership/lease truth or an IDE-owned ledger. Recommended split: producer transport with tests first, then I03 Kotlin consumer with tests; I06 remains sole final hardening task. REPL asked daemon API vs host CLI preference, but this block is grounded in missing source/contract, NOT lack of a reply. Preserve all existing dependencies and no activation.
